description.value:
Requirements Your turret is Deployed and within 150 feet.

You overload your turret's systems, causing it to self-destruct in a volatile explosion. Your turret deals @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/4)+1)d6[piercing],(floor(@actor.level/4)+1)d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15]. Creatures in the area can attempt a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic|options:area-effect] save against your class DC. Your turret is reduced to 0 Hit Points and automatically recalled to your custom rig.

At 8th level and every 4 levels thereafter, both the piercing damage and the fire damage increase by 1d6.
